WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: bovine voice
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a cow-like voice, mooing when they are happy and huffing through their nostrils when they are mad.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: ruminant stomach
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are born with large and hardy digestive systems, allowing them to eat hay. They will eat hay when there are no fine meals around, however, they require a lot more food to feel full.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: unguligrade legs
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene are born with sturdy legs and cloven hooves. The fur on their legs extends up to their stomachs and covers their groin.

WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.label: estrous cycle
WantsAndQuirks.RewardDef.description: Carriers of this gene go into heat during Aprimay. While in heat, they will crave lovin' more than usual at the cost of having intense mood swings.\n\nPawns that are permanently sterilized or pregnant will not go into heat.
